description: Compare two SPL mints using decimals, supply, mint and freeze authorities, and top-ten token-account concentration. It reports chain facts side by side and does not rank tokens as investments. Cost: 1 credit (0.0022 SOL). Example: {"mintA":"EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v","mintB":"So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"}

mintA.description: First SPL token mint address in Base58 format.

mintB.description: Second SPL token mint address in Base58 format.

network.description: Solana cluster to query. Use mainnet-beta for real assets or devnet for test data; defaults to mainnet-beta.

name: compare_tokens
